All exact source files replayed with stored outputs. Finite proof is complete; no infinite inference.

value.rationale: Corrects a Coxeter-specific published value 14 to the sharp value 10 with a completely reproducible witness and degree bound. The deeper 28-state sphere classification and sharp four-at-a-time reconfiguration transition give an exact finite structural invariant for a canonical symmetric cubic graph; these are not mere relabelings or small routine parameter variations. The explicit exchange graph is a graph-distance relation with diameter three.
